title: Swiss robotics
subtitle: A niche mapped and a shortlist read before any approach
note: An example of how a buyer reads a niche. The companies are public register entries: nothing here says any of them is for sale or has been approached, and nothing is alleged. Every finding is an Antevo engine's answer on 25 November 2026.

tries.label: The shortlist, company by company
tries.source: Antevo Companies and Antevo Trademark, 25 Nov 2026 · Zefix, SHAB, GLEIF, OFAC, EU, UK and SECO lists. For all three: no parent on record, not found on the four sanctions lists, no article in Antevo's news reading since 18 May.

items.name: Ferrant Robotics AG
evidence: Active, seat in canton Zurich; its stated purpose is software and hardware for robots that learn
24 register notices since February 2019, four this year (24 and 27 February, 12 June, 2 November)
One EU trademark, pending, in classes 7, 9 and 42

items.name: Quintal Robotics AG
evidence: Active, seat in canton Bern; its stated purpose is rationalisation and automation technology
8 register notices since September 2019, three this year (21 January, 17 September, 6 November)
No trademark filings under its name in the registers Antevo reads

items.name: Talgen Robotics AG
evidence: Active, seat in canton Bern; its stated purpose is automated production systems
2 register notices, on 8 March 2024 and 21 November 2025
No trademark filings under its name in the registers Antevo reads

steps.label: Before a first approach, with the links

items.do: Read today's register extract for each: purpose, capital and who may sign
items.why: Who may sign decides who the first conversation is with.
Ferrant Robotics had four and Quintal Robotics three; each notice says what changed.

items.do: Check patents and designs, not only trademarks
items.why: Two of the three have no trademark filings in the registers read; what protects their products may be patents, know-how or nothing registered.

items.do: Ask who owns each company, under a confidentiality agreement
items.why: Owners who are people are not public in Switzerland, and no parent is on record for any of the three.
At most one alert a day when a register notice or a sanctions list changes, and Ferrant Robotics' next trademark filing.

sections.title: The niche
sections.verdict: Ten companies, seats from Geneva to Ticino
sections.so_what: The niche spans the French, German and Italian-speaking regions: a buyer's plan for people and customers has to work in all three.
evidence: The first ten register matches for "robotics": nine companies limited by shares and one limited liability company
Seats in Meggen, Balerna, Lugano, Glattbrugg, Pully, Schindellegi, Gals, Burgdorf, Plan-les-Ouates and Basel
sections.source: Antevo Companies, 25 Nov 2026 (Zefix). The search returns ten at a time.

sections.title: Financing
sections.so_what: If the deal needs debt, terms before and after the SNB's 10 December assessment may differ: fixing early or pricing a later rise in are both options.
evidence: SNB policy rate 0.00% (October 2026), held since June 2025; Swiss inflation rose to 1.5% in October
Most forecasters expect a first rise in March 2027; some expect one as soon as December
10-year Swiss government bond yield 0.51% (third quarter)

sections.title: The franc
sections.so_what: A company selling to Germany in euros earns fewer francs per sale: ask for margins by currency.
evidence: EUR/CHF 0.9162 on 24 November
The franc is 1.6% stronger against the euro than a year ago

sections.title: Customers in Germany
sections.so_what: Ask for order intake since September: firmer German demand would show there first.
evidence: German manufacturing survey at 55 in November; business climate 90.6
German producer prices up 8.1% on the year in October, an incentive to automate in the desk's reading
sections.source: Antevo Research and Antevo Strategy Radar, 24 to 25 Nov 2026

sections.title: Market strain
sections.so_what: Prices can move between a first offer and signing: a price-adjustment clause or a short exclusivity are options.
evidence: Week of 20 November: elevated, down from high the week before (3.8 times a normal week)
Bonds, commodities and volatility are breaking; credit is calm
sections.source: Antevo Tremor Watch, week of 20 Nov 2026 (provisional)

sections.title: AI funding
sections.so_what: If a company sells into chip or data-centre projects, ask how much of its order book depends on them.
evidence: A failed or repriced AI bond or share sale could make funding dearer and trim chip and power orders
High impact, medium likelihood, rising

links.text: Two of the three have no trademark filings in the registers read: what a buyer pays for may sit in patents, know-how or nothing registered, and that is the first question.
Franc money is cheap while markets are unsettled: financing is not the constraint, a price that moves before signing is.
German factories are expanding as their costs rise: if automation demand is turning, a robotics maker selling into Germany would see it in orders first.
